title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka, Veranda]
description: A lacquered cottonwood pergola, its crossbeams draped with thick honeysuckle vines, filters sunlight into shifting patterns upon a brightly colored mosaic centered within the cobblestone patio floor.  Scattered tables along the fenceline offer seating along with a view of the apiary beyond, while others are clustered closer to a pair of stained glass doors offering entry to the meadery.  The gentle hum of bees drifts across from the nearby hives, a constant, peaceful accompaniment to the clink of glasses and low conversation of those gathered.
